M3 — 2026-09-29
Claude Code 2.1.284 keys its macOS keychain OAuth item by config dir. The service is `Claude Code<suffix>-credentials-<sha256(dir)[:8]>` whenever CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is set, so a fresh CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR reads as "Not logged in". Setting CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR to the logged-in profile's dir makes the hash use that dir instead. Swapping HOME breaks auth outright, because the login keychain is found via HOME. Source: strings of ~/.bench/claude-2.1.284/claude (function wN), read 2026-09-29.
